new_breakage.details: R2 exact argv comparison consumes P1 process_snapshot stdout using UTF-8 errors=replace. The selected Windows PowerShell pipe actually emits GB2312. A fresh bounded CIM query filtered only to the pinned Python probe process returned its Chinese argument exactly when decoded as GBK and corrupted it using the P1 decoder. R2 candidate_valid compares that corrupted value to the original Unicode query. If the child is present, it becomes ambiguous after Popen has already dispatched, its identity is omitted from the termination set, and ownership/cleanup cannot be assured. Record own-argv-proof.json includes the raw JSON bytes and both comparisons. Require lossless OS argv transport and exercise actual Owned.launch/discover/cleanup with the Chinese/multiline arguments using a harmless headless process. Keep ambiguous identities outside termination authority.

The first independent raw hash is checked against the service. A subsequent output_inventory detects new raw bytes, but mechanical compares only the pathname set (260). A controlled pure call using the existing valid R2 test fixture plus a different later SHA returned mechanical PASS. The final effects snapshot also can contain a different file hash/set, text or caret without an errors entry (392–406). Match every required final, actually observed state to the accepted evidence, or record overall FAIL/unknown with the conflicting observations preserved. Do not infer any mutations occurred on this host from this synthetic reproducer.
